prose: Microsoft confirmed that 2026 Surface PCs drop the 'Copilot+ PC' brand, closing a category launched in 2024 with Qualcomm as the baseline for 'AI-first' Windows hardware with exclusive features gated behind new system requirements.

Windows Central's account of why: the launch never recovered from its debut disaster. Security researchers found Recall, the blockbuster Copilot+ feature, woefully insecure; Microsoft had to delay Recall and ship the new category without its leading AI experience, tarnishing the brand from day one. Dropping the name is the quiet acknowledgment. (Summary based on Windows Central's article via Techmeme.)
highlights: 2026 Surface PCs drop the Copilot+ PC brand, Microsoft confirms
The 2024 launch gated exclusive AI features behind new hardware requirements
Recall, the flagship feature, shipped late after being found 'woefully insecure'
The brand never recovered from launching without its leading feature
Summary from Windows Central's report via Techmeme
